x: Mitchell gained 4th place in the 11 miles Road Race at Harrow on Boxing Day morning. He beat, among others, G.
Surrey A.C. won with 17 points, we were second with 23 points and Herne Hill Harriers third with 30 points. The race, in which fifteen Clubs started teams, was won by G.
He later returned to the Old Malden Fields to pit his new-found fitness against Surrey A.C. runners and found cross-country specialist George Constable on the line.
